title: How Three Teens Fell into a HUGE Trap While Committing Fraud

On October 30, 2023, the Martin County Sheriff’s Office was alerted to a black vehicle possibly tied to thefts in Hobe Sound, FL. Detectives spotted it driving recklessly before it left a Walmart.
